speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: God, I love the smell of paintballs in the morning.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: There's no way we can get to the ridge. The Chemistry Department has us completely cut off.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: But what about the creek bed?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: The Pharmacology Department controls that, and they're all hopped up on experimental steroids.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Well, that's it then, we're doomed.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I think the time has come to acknowledge that we are paying the price for some of us failing to attend my Physics Department paintball strategy meeting.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I told you my mom has spider veins, I had to take her to the laser clinic.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: And I told you I wanted to see a doctor's note.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: We need a plan. How about Operation Hammer of the Gods?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I forget. Which one is Hammer of the Gods?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: We hide behind the Dumpsters in the parking lot and ambush people when they come to pee.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: No go. The Dumpsters are deep in Astronomy Department territory.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: No, that shouldn't be a problem, Venus is up during the day. They're probably just all staring at the sky.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All right, what we need now is a tactical retreat. Did you see the episode of Stargate where they found themselves on a planet with a culture based loosely on Earth's Athens and Sparta? Not important. Leonard, Raj and I are going to burst out the door and run away, Howard will cover us.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Why don't I run away and you cover me?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Because you chose your mother's veins over victory. On three. One, two, three, go!
